source_message: Hey, this is Alex Turner from Platform submitting request IT-061 for 2026-10-22. I am asking for new read access to Forge (staging) for the dates 2026-10-26 through 2026-10-28. Nia Patel is my manager. I am looking at the example pipeline runs to figure out why the starter project takes longer to build some of the time. I want to look at the run timestamps and compare to the template versions. I am going to share this info with the people who are managing the examples.
